image_description: A close-up, high-resolution portrait of a wood rabbit (cottontail) situated in natural grassy vegetation. The rabbit is facing slightly to the right, with its head and upper torso clearly visible. The fur texture is detailed, showing individual hairs in shades of brown, grey, and black. One ear is fully visible and upright, while the other is partially cut off by the frame edge. The eye is dark, round, and reflective. The nose and mouth area are partially obscured by blades of grass in the immediate foreground.

selected_experts.reason: Primary verification of species identity (wood rabbit vs. similar lagomorphs) and taxonomic accuracy.
Verify structural integrity of the head-neck connection and ear placement, ensuring no anatomical fusion or asymmetry errors.
Audit the boundary between the fur and the foreground/background grass to detect edge bleeding, haloing, or melting artifacts common in AI generation.
Analyze micro-texture consistency of the fur to ensure it doesn't exhibit plastic-like smoothing or repetitive pattern artifacts.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interface between the rabbit's whiskers/muzzle and the foreground grass. AI models often struggle with fine linear structures intersecting complex backgrounds, leading to fused or disappearing whiskers. Also, verify if the eye reflection matches the implied lighting direction of the scene.
